paite: Atawp pen in unaute aw, Toupa thu noumau lak a a-om bang in, khang a hih thupi a a-omtheihna ding leh,
heading: Thumsak Ding A Ngetna
english: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,

paite: migenhakte leh migiloute lak a ka bit theihna ding un, hon thumsak un; mi tengteng in lah ginna anei vek kei uhi.
english: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.

paite: Himahleh Toupa amuanhuai a, ama'n noute hon phutkip in giloupa a pan ahon veng ding hi.
english: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.

paite: K'on thupiak peuhmah uh na hihzou ua, na hih zelzel uh leng Toupa ah ka hon gingta uhi.
english: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.

paite: Toupa'n na lungtangte uh Pathian itna ah leh Khrist kuhkalna ah pilut hen.
english: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.

paite: Huan unaute aw, koute a kipan a thuhilhna amuh bang ua om lou nasep thadah, dan lou bang a om unau tengteng a pan kihemkhe ding in i Toupa Jesu Khrist min in thu ka hon pia uhi.
heading: Thanuam Ding A Thuhilhna
english: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.

paite: Na kiang ua ka om lai un, dan lou bang in ka gamta ngei kei uh chih leh noumau mahmah in na hon zuihdan ding uh na thei uhi.
english: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,

paite: Kuamah khut a kipan athawn in na tanghou uh leng ka ne ngei kei uh; noute ka hon tuailuai saklouhna ding un sun leh zan a gim leh tawltak a sem kawm in ka ne zaw zel uhi.
english: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you.

paite: Huai thuneihna ka neih louh ziak uh hilou in, ka omdan uh na zuih ding ua etton ding hon pia ka hi zaw hi.
english: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.

paite: Na kiang ua ka om lai un; kuapeuh in nna asepnop keileh nek leng ne kei hen, chi in thu ka hon pia uhi.
english: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”

paite: Na lak ua khenkhat dan lou a omte tungtang ka za uhi, huaite'n nna himhim asem kei ua, midangte nasep ah akichinglah zaw uhi.
english: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.

paite: Huchi ahih chiang in, huai mite nasem hiathiat ding leh amau tanghou ne ding in Toupa Jesu Khrist ah thu pia in ka hanthawn uhi.
english: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.

paite: Unaute aw, nou zaw thil hoih hih chimtak kei un.
english: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.

paite: Huan kuapeuh in hiai ka laikhak ua ka thu uh azuih kei uleh, na kithuahpih hetlouhna ding un chiamteh un, azumtheihna ding in.
english: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.

paite: Ahi, melma bang in en kei unla, unau bang in hilh zaw un.
english: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

paite: Tu in muanna Toupa'n kong chiteng ah noute hon khamuan tawntung hen. Toupa na vek ua lak ah om hen.
heading: Thu Nanungte
english: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

paite: Kei, Paul in, keimah khut a hiai chibai bukna ka gelh ahi; hiai ka laikhak teng ah chiamtehna ahi; hichibang ka gelhdan ahi.
english: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na vek ua tung ah om hen. Amen.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
